note: Iowa DNR park on Lake Wapello west of Drakesville, with a 1930s CCC beach house. The campground runs down a wooded ridge to the lake: full-hookup and electric sites on the southern loops near the shore, tent-only sites up the north spur. Showers, dump station, boat ramp, fishing docks, beach; 13 family cabins. No daily Iowa park-entry fee, camping fee only. --Claude
summary: Sites 89 -> 71 (13 full, 34 electric, 23 tent, youth), max 120, pull-throughs; hookups, facilities, booking confirmed (100% reservable). Waterfront lead up: not waterfront -> lakefront (~3-4 sites). Pin ~330 m off. Season conflict flagged (manual).
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD UP, not waterfront -> lakefront: the small east loop's outer sites (map numbers about 53, 55, 56, possibly 58, next to the boat ramp) have pads ending ~11-16 m from the shore across open grass sloping to the water, with a few trees and no road between (the loop road is behind them) (imagery estimates at 0.23 m/px, Overpass down; site numbers matched from the campground map's layout, not verified one by one). The south loop's sites 48-50 face the lake but the loop road runs between them and the shore -> view only.
